title: Moong dal chilla (lentil pancakes) with mint soya yoghurt
steps: Soak the moong dal for at least 3 hours (or overnight) and drain.
Blend with the ginger, chilli, cumin, turmeric, salt and about 100 ml water to a smooth batter.
Stir in the finely diced tomato and chopped coriander.
Oil a pan thinly, spread a ladle of batter thinly and cook for 2 minutes per side until golden.
Stir the soya yoghurt with chopped mint and serve alongside.
